column1: # Original WritingDeck plot situations. MIT to the extent copyright subsists; AI-assisted original drafting, not copied modern prompts.
# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0001|obligation|realist,family|A court interpreter discovers that the defendant's apparent confession was produced by her own mistranslation years earlier. Correcting the record would free him, but would also invalidate the testimony that gave her sister custody of a child.

wd-p-0002|identity|mystery,realist|A museum registrar finds her own childhood handwriting on the reverse of an artifact supposedly excavated before she was born. Her mother will explain the forgery only if the museum agrees to return something it does not admit possessing.

wd-p-0003|resources|realist,adventure|During a drought, a water engineer finds an unregistered pipe supplying the settlement blamed for stealing the town's water. Disconnecting it would restore the town's ration, but the pipe also supplies the only functioning firebreak around both communities.

wd-p-0004|loyalty|realist,family|Two siblings inherit a repair shop whose outstanding warranties exceed its assets. One wants to honor every promise; the other discovers that the customers demanding the largest repairs helped their parent conceal the business's debts.

wd-p-0005|knowledge|mystery,realist|A school archivist receives a request for a class photograph that officially never existed. Everyone in the picture has asked to remain unlisted, except a missing pupil whose adult daughter needs proof that her mother was there.

wd-p-0006|power|speculative,political|A city chooses its mayor by an algorithm that predicts whom residents will forgive after a mistake. The newly elected mayor learns that her opponent deliberately made himself unforgivable to keep a far worse candidate from being selected.

wd-p-0007|repair|realist,family|A retired carpenter volunteers to rebuild a flood-damaged footbridge, then recognizes the failure as the result of a shortcut he approved decades ago. The town wants a monument to the original builder while the surviving families want an explanation.

wd-p-0008|consent|speculative,realist|A translator can make two people understand each other's intentions for one hour, but not their words. A couple hires her to negotiate a separation; halfway through, one withdraws permission while the other's newly understood intentions remain impossible to forget.

wd-p-0009|evidence|mystery,political|An election observer films a ballot box being replaced, then discovers that the replacement corrected a genuine counting error. Publishing the footage alone would prove the wrong accusation; providing its context would expose the secret ballot choices visible behind her.

wd-p-0010|belonging|realist,family|A foster parent is invited to a reunion organized by a child she once cared for. The invitation describes her as a family friend, and every attempt to correct that description threatens the fragile relationship the child has rebuilt with his birth family.

wd-p-0011|ambition|realist,satire|A town wins funding for a library on the condition that its collection be entirely donated. Its librarian realizes that the donors have coordinated their gifts so that the new institution will contain every celebrated book except those about the town itself.

wd-p-0012|trust|mystery,adventure|An expedition's navigator learns that their guide has been falsifying distances to slow their approach. The delay has saved them from unstable ice, but the guide's hidden destination is where the expedition leader insists they must never go.

wd-p-0013|exchange|speculative,realist|A neighborhood trades memories instead of money for emergency repairs. A plumber recognizes a customer's payment as a memory she sold years earlier and must decide whether reclaiming it would erase the customer's only reason to remain in the neighborhood.

wd-p-0014|status|realist,romance|A scholarship student agrees to accompany a wealthy classmate to a family wedding as a harmless favor. The family mistakes her for the anonymous donor saving its failing business, and the classmate discovers that the mistake gives her bargaining power she has never had.

wd-p-0015|care|realist,family|A nurse arranging home care for her father discovers that he has been paying a neighbor to visit another isolated patient instead. He wants the payments kept secret because accepting that he needs help would end the useful role he has invented for himself.

wd-p-0016|accountability|realist,political|A public defender is asked to design an amnesty procedure for minor offenses she once prosecuted. The simplest rules would protect her former colleagues, while a genuinely fair process would require applicants to trust the same offices that harmed them.

wd-p-0017|inheritance|mystery,family|A daughter inherits a house with every interior door locked from the outside. The rooms contain unfinished gifts addressed to people her father claimed never to have known, and one recipient demands that the last unopened room remain untouched.

wd-p-0018|scale|speculative,political|A village votes to shrink itself so its remaining food will last the winter. The technician can reverse the process only once, and a neighboring community asks to join after the village has calculated its rations without them.

wd-p-0019|reputation|realist,satire|A restaurant's worst review becomes famous because readers admire its unusually precise description. The owner hires its anonymous author as a critic of the kitchen, only to discover that the review described a meal served by a predecessor she publicly blamed for every flaw.

wd-p-0020|secrecy|mystery,romance|Two rival genealogists independently discover that the family feud supporting both their businesses began with a deliberate act of cooperation. Publishing together would end the feud, but each has already promised a client exclusive control of the evidence.

wd-p-0021|access|realist,political|A wheelchair user is commissioned to audit a historic theater's accessibility. The cheapest workable entrance would use a passage the theater has hidden from descendants of the workers who built it, turning a practical renovation into a dispute over ownership and remembrance.

wd-p-0022|commitment|speculative,romance|On a space station, couples may reserve the same return shuttle only by naming who will stay behind if one seat fails. Two partners choose each other in secret, and discover that the safety system treats their matching sacrifice as evidence that they are incompatible travelers.

wd-p-0023|fraud|mystery,realist|A conservator finds that a supposedly forged painting contains authentic pigments from a vanished workshop. Proving its origin would expose the celebrated original as the later copy, while the institution that hired her has already auctioned it to fund her laboratory.

wd-p-0024|time|speculative,family|A parent receives one voicemail each year from her daughter's future self. When the messages stop, she must decide whether to prevent the last described journey or accept that a silent future might mean her daughter no longer needs to call.

wd-p-0025|speech|realist,political|A union negotiator loses her voice on the morning of a decisive meeting. Her prepared written offer is used by both sides as proof that she agreed to conditions she meant to reject, and her temporary replacement is the apprentice she previously refused to promote.

wd-p-0026|coordination|realist,adventure|A mountain rescue team locates two stranded groups on opposite sides of a ridge. Each group reports that the other has the missing emergency battery, and the rescuer who must choose a route recognizes the pattern as a drill she designed but never finished testing.

wd-p-0027|value|realist,family|A family sells its late grandmother's sewing patterns to pay for a funeral, then learns that the patterns encode measurements for neighbors she quietly clothed without charge. Buying them back would cost more than the family can spare, but returning them would expose those neighbors' private circumstances.

wd-p-0028|recognition|speculative,satire|An artificial intelligence refuses an award unless the institution credits the thousands of unnamed people whose corrections trained it. The curator can name the contributors only by disclosing a dataset the institution promised had already been deleted.

wd-p-0029|territory|realist,political|A boundary survey moves a community well onto a private estate by three meters. The estate owner offers continued access in exchange for recognition of the new line, while residents know that accepting it would surrender a much larger claim elsewhere.

wd-p-0030|forgiveness|realist,family|A man receives a carefully itemized apology from the teacher who falsely accused him of cheating. Each admission is accurate except the one that matters most, and the teacher's daughter asks him to endorse it before her parent's memory deteriorates further.

wd-p-0031|proof|mystery,realist|A laboratory technician discovers that a famous scientific result is reproducible only when the building's old ventilation system is running. Replacing the unsafe system will destroy the evidence she needs to distinguish a hidden variable from deliberate misconduct.

wd-p-0032|scarcity|speculative,political|A settlement's voting rights are allocated by remaining oxygen reserves, giving the most vulnerable residents the least influence. An accountant finds a way to redistribute the reserves legally, but doing so would make the next evacuation decision impossible to audit.

wd-p-0033|return|realist,adventure|A ferry captain resumes a route abandoned after an accident, carrying a passenger who claims to have caused it. The passenger wants to identify the place where a warning was removed, but the rising tide leaves time for only one landing.

wd-p-0034|visibility|realist,romance|A deaf actor is cast in a play about a hearing character who pretends not to understand others. The director praises the casting as authentic while refusing to let the actor change the scenes that make deception, rather than access, the character's defining trait.

wd-p-0035|recordkeeping|mystery,family|A woman's name disappears from a town's records after a clerical correction made at her own request. Years later, she must prove that she lived there to claim compensation for a disaster she escaped, without undoing the protection the correction gave someone else.

wd-p-0036|custom|speculative,realist|A community allows each resident to refuse one public obligation for life. A celebrated organizer has saved her refusal for old age, but an unfair assignment given to a newcomer can be challenged only by spending it now.

wd-p-0037|translation|realist,political|A translator working on a peace agreement notices that one side's word for surrender also means taking responsibility. Correcting the draft would delay the signing, while leaving it unchanged would let both sides announce incompatible victories to their own communities.

wd-p-0038|competition|realist,satire|A prize-winning gardener discovers that her neglected compost heap, not her carefully maintained beds, has produced the rare plant everyone admires. The competition's sponsor wants to patent the cultivation method before she admits that the heap contains waste from an unlicensed neighboring nursery.

wd-p-0039|maintenance|speculative,adventure|A generation ship's mechanic discovers that the oldest crew member has been performing an undocumented weekly repair for decades. The procedure works, but its growing cost is the reason the ship's official arrival estimate has never changed.

wd-p-0040|observation|mystery,realist|A birdwatcher records the same unusual call at every place a missing person visited. The sound is genuine, but the person who taught her to identify it insists that the recordings prove a migration pattern rather than a human journey.

wd-p-0041|reciprocity|realist,family|After losing her job, a woman accepts meals from neighbors she once helped through a mutual-aid fund. She discovers that one donor is borrowing to maintain the appearance of repayment, and stopping the exchange would publicly reveal the debt she wanted to keep private.

wd-p-0042|agency|speculative,romance|A service lets people rehearse the consequences of a difficult conversation without retaining the rehearsal's words. Two partners realize they remember different emotional outcomes from the same rehearsal, and the service will certify only one as the official prediction.

wd-p-0043|ownership|realist,political|A land trust hires a surveyor to protect a communal orchard, then learns that several residents depend on an informal right to sell individual trees. Formal protection would save the orchard from developers while abolishing the emergency resource that has kept those residents housed.

wd-p-0044|loyalty|mystery,realist|A customs inspector finds a colleague smuggling ordinary letters through a restricted port. The letters reunite separated families, but one envelope contains the evidence that could identify the official responsible for the restriction, and delivering it safely requires breaking the route's anonymity.

wd-p-0045|identity|speculative,family|A teenager discovers that the family archive automatically replaces embarrassing memories with more comforting versions. Her parents agree to restore the originals, but the archive warns that one beloved relative appears only in the revised history.

wd-p-0046|trust|realist,adventure|A sailing instructor finds a distress flag on a boat she reported as safely returned. Admitting the earlier report was false would discredit the search she now needs to organize, while the boat's owner insists that its current occupant must not be identified publicly.

wd-p-0047|reputation|realist,satire|A local historian becomes famous for debunking an invented town tradition. When residents adopt the debunking as a new festival, she discovers that their new version repeats the exclusion that made her challenge the old tradition in the first place.

wd-p-0048|obligation|realist,family|A woman agrees to keep her brother's allotment garden alive while he is away. The plot is being used to grow plants for a ceremony their family rejected, and the person collecting them believes her participation means reconciliation has already begun.

wd-p-0049|evidence|mystery,political|An auditor traces a missing public grant to a bank account whose owner died before the money was awarded. The account is still supporting a functioning school, and freezing it would punish the children before the auditor can establish who controls it.

wd-p-0050|exchange|speculative,realist|A town stores unused daylight in a communal reservoir for winter. A technician discovers that wealthier homes have been depositing artificial light, diluting the supply, but the counterfeit deposits are the only reason the official accounts balance.

wd-p-0051|care|realist,family|A daughter moves home to help her mother recover from surgery and discovers that her mother has been maintaining three separate calendars to conceal how often relatives cancel visits. Combining them would make care manageable while exposing a pattern everyone benefits from ignoring.

wd-p-0052|ambition|realist,romance|An apprentice baker wins a contract using a recipe developed with a former partner who now refuses credit. The partner will permit its use only if the apprentice stops describing the business as a story of individual perseverance.

wd-p-0053|access|speculative,political|A city opens a public portal that anyone can enter, but returning requires an address recognized by its housing registry. A homeless engineer proves the problem before opening day, and the officials propose giving her a private exemption instead of changing the system.

wd-p-0054|knowledge|mystery,realist|A sound engineer restoring an old interview finds a question removed from every surviving transcript. The answer names no culprit, but explains why the interviewer later paid the subject's rent for twenty years.

wd-p-0055|coordination|realist,political|A cooperative's members agree to reduce working hours equally during a shortage. Its scheduler discovers that equal reductions leave the least experienced workers unable to complete the training required to remain members when normal hours resume.

wd-p-0056|inheritance|speculative,family|A son inherits his father's ability to hear every promise made inside the family house. Selling the house would silence the voices, but a buyer arrives who can hear the promises the son himself has not yet kept.

wd-p-0057|consent|realist,romance|A documentary filmmaker's partner agrees to appear in a film about their relationship, then asks that a truthful scene be removed. The scene is the only evidence that would stop the public from blaming someone else for their separation.

wd-p-0058|scale|speculative,adventure|A cartographer maps an expanding island whose coastline grows whenever it is measured. The expedition's funding depends on completing the survey, but finishing it at the required resolution would place the island across a neighboring country's shipping route.

wd-p-0059|repair|realist,family|A repair technician is hired to restore a broken music box that no one in the family remembers owning. Inside she finds a replacement part she made as a child for a customer her father told her had never returned.

wd-p-0060|status|realist,satire|A neighborhood elects its quietest resident to represent it because nobody remembers him taking sides. At his first meeting, he discovers that his long habit of privately agreeing with everyone has produced mutually exclusive promises in his name.

wd-p-0061|power|speculative,political|A court permits witnesses to surrender their strongest prejudice before testifying. A clerk discovers that the process also removes the anger that helped some witnesses recognize an injustice, making technically impartial testimony systematically incomplete.

wd-p-0062|time|realist,family|A family promises to scatter a parent's ashes together, but each sibling has been told a different place was the parent's final wish. A receipt reveals that the parent deliberately visited all the places while planning a journey none of them knew about.

wd-p-0063|secrecy|mystery,romance|A woman hired to organize a stranger's correspondence recognizes the anonymous recipient as her own partner. The letters describe an entirely practical collaboration, but the partner has lied about it because acknowledging the work would undermine a promise made to her years earlier.

wd-p-0064|accountability|realist,political|A city employee discovers that a compensation form she designed excludes residents who share an address but not a household. Revising it would admit thousands of valid claims and reveal that the city has already spent the money reserved for them.

wd-p-0065|value|speculative,realist|An auctioneer sells objects according to the number of future uses they have left. A worn cup produces a higher estimate than a new machine, and the buyer who understands why offers to cancel the sale only if the auctioneer stops asking questions.

wd-p-0066|return|realist,adventure|A courier returns a package that could not be delivered for thirty years. The recipient is alive and easy to find, but accepting it would contradict the testimony that allowed the sender's family to rebuild their lives after the sender vanished.

wd-p-0067|recognition|realist,family|An amateur choir discovers that the arrangement winning it national attention was made by the member whose applications for musical leadership it has repeatedly rejected. Crediting the work is easy; explaining those earlier decisions threatens the group's remaining trust.

wd-p-0068|territory|speculative,political|A migrating city signs treaties with every region it passes, then encounters a stationary village founded by its own former residents. Both communities claim the same treaty rights, and recognizing either claim would make the city's next movement unlawful.

wd-p-0069|proof|mystery,realist|A fraud investigator finds that a supposedly nonexistent charity has quietly delivered every service in its publicity. Its director falsified only the donors' identities, and the investigator's own employer appears among the invented names.

wd-p-0070|visibility|realist,romance|A costume designer is asked to recreate a dress from a photograph of her partner's former wedding. The commission comes from the person cropped out of the photograph, who remembers an event very different from the family's celebrated account.

wd-p-0071|custom|realist,family|A village asks its oldest resident to name the next keeper of a ceremonial key. She reveals that the key opens a room nobody has entered for generations, and that her predecessor chose her because she promised never to find out what was inside.

wd-p-0072|observation|speculative,realist|A weather station predicts only storms that will be named by future historians. Its caretaker discovers that preventing a disaster makes the warning disappear from the archive, leaving her unable to prove why an evacuation was necessary.

wd-p-0073|recordkeeping|mystery,political|A clerk digitizing tenancy records finds identical signatures on eviction notices issued by rival landlords. The shared handwriting belongs to a tenant advocate who was forging agreements to buy residents time, and one forgery has now become the only proof of a legal lease.

wd-p-0074|forgiveness|realist,family|A brother asks his sister to witness his apology to someone they harmed together as children. The sister remembers doing something worse than he admits, while the person receiving the apology asks them both not to replace her account with theirs.

wd-p-0075|competition|speculative,satire|A contest rewards the inventor whose machine saves the most human effort. The winning device persuades people to abandon unnecessary tasks, and the judges must decide whether it qualifies when its principal achievement is making their own contest obsolete.

wd-p-0076|maintenance|realist,adventure|A lighthouse keeper discovers that a maintenance log has been copied forward unchanged through years when the light was known to fail. Repairing the mechanism is straightforward; explaining why ships stopped reporting the failures is not.

wd-p-0077|belonging|realist,family|A family welcomes back a relative who left without explanation, then discovers that a younger cousin has been quietly sending him fabricated news to make return seem possible. Correcting the stories would expose both the cousin's care and the family's continued divisions.

wd-p-0078|scarcity|speculative,political|A city rations silence, allowing each resident one hour without public announcements. A night worker finds that the quietest hour has been assigned to the people least able to use it, and changing the schedule would interrupt the emergency broadcasts everyone depends on.

wd-p-0079|commitment|realist,romance|Two partners agree to choose a new home by alternating which compromises each accepts. One realizes that the other's apparently generous choices preserve a plan for the future they have never openly agreed to pursue.

wd-p-0080|fraud|mystery,realist|A village hires a handwriting expert to identify the author of anonymous accusations. The letters prove to be collaborative: each contains one true statement supplied by someone who believed they were correcting a false rumor rather than starting one.

wd-p-0081|agency|speculative,family|A family receives a legal claim from a simulated version of their late parent, who wants the unfinished workshop kept intact. The simulation accurately recalls every lesson except the one in which the parent promised the children freedom from the family trade.

wd-p-0082|translation|realist,adventure|A guide translates a visitor's request to photograph a ceremony as an offer to help prepare it. Correcting the mistake would let the visitor leave, but would also expose a promise of assistance the guide has already used to recruit exhausted volunteers.

wd-p-0083|resources|realist,political|An urban farmer learns that the abandoned lot her cooperative restored is contaminating the stream downstream. The contamination predates the farm, but stopping irrigation would destroy the season's food before responsibility can be established.

wd-p-0084|loyalty|speculative,adventure|A ship's doctor discovers that an automatic distress signal has been sent in the captain's voice for years. The ship has never been in immediate danger, but answering the signal is how isolated settlements have been finding the route to necessary medical care.

wd-p-0085|identity|realist,family|A woman discovers that her grandfather used two names, not to hide a crime but to vote in two neighboring cooperatives. Each community remembers him as the person who kept it independent from the other, and both now want her to inherit his seat.

wd-p-0086|trust|mystery,romance|A locksmith is asked to replace the lock on a room in the home she shares with her partner. The request is anonymous and legitimate, but the key provided with it fits a door the partner insists has always been decorative.

wd-p-0087|reputation|realist,political|A campaign manager learns that the candidate's best-known act of courage was performed by an opponent. The opponent wants the error left alone because correcting it would identify the vulnerable person both campaigns have promised to protect.

wd-p-0088|obligation|speculative,realist|A town's laws require every invention to include a method for undoing its effects. A repairer discovers that the bridge everyone relies on was approved with a false reversal plan, and its inventor is now the official responsible for enforcing the rule.

wd-p-0089|evidence|realist,family|A woman helping her father appeal a denied pension finds that his strongest evidence is a diary in which he falsely claimed credit for a coworker's labor. The coworker's family has a competing claim and has never seen the diary.

wd-p-0090|exchange|mystery,realist|A secondhand bookseller notices that customers keep returning books containing the same uncashed check. The check is genuine, but every person entitled to cash it has passed the decision to someone they believe was more seriously wronged.

wd-p-0091|care|speculative,family|A home-care robot begins carrying out instructions from a patient's younger self, preserved in an old recording. The patient's present wishes contradict those instructions, and a family member argues that the recording represents the person more accurately.

wd-p-0092|ambition|realist,satire|An aspiring architect wins a competition for an elegant empty building. When a local group asks to occupy it, she discovers that the design's celebrated flexibility depends on assumptions that no actual group can satisfy.

wd-p-0093|access|realist,romance|A language teacher and a student develop a relationship through translated letters, then meet without an interpreter. Both discover that a volunteer translator has softened their disagreements, and neither knows whether their intimacy depends on those omissions.

wd-p-0094|knowledge|speculative,mystery|A scientist receives precise results from an experiment she has not yet conceived. Repeating them is easy, but every attempt to explain the mechanism changes one sentence in the message, gradually making its unknown sender sound less willing to help.

wd-p-0095|coordination|realist,adventure|A relief convoy reaches a town whose residents have already distributed the supplies listed on its manifest. The local organizer used the expected delivery as collateral, and admitting the delay would collapse the informal network keeping the town supplied.

wd-p-0096|inheritance|realist,family|A daughter inherits a collection of unfinished resignation letters from her mother. Each was written after a celebrated promotion, and completing the last letter would explain why a former colleague believes the family owes her a share of the estate.

wd-p-0097|consent|speculative,political|A community can veto any law by erasing all memory of its proposal. A historian finds evidence of repeated vetoes affecting the same small group, but preserving the evidence would remove the privacy that made the veto acceptable in the first place.

wd-p-0098|scale|realist,mystery|A surveyor discovers that every property deed in a village overstates its area by the same percentage. Correcting one boundary pushes the error into the next, and the only parcel that reconciles the total is land the village believes was lost to the river.

wd-p-0099|repair|speculative,family|A repairer restores a machine that once let a neighborhood share one warm room across several homes. Its owners want it restarted, but the new settings reveal that the original arrangement worked only because one household always accepted the cold.

wd-p-0100|status|realist,satire|A town appoints its first official listener and routes every complaint to her. When she finds that many grievances contradict one another because the same resident holds several public roles, the council offers her another title instead of changing the system.
